title: Maa Sadqe Maa Wari Akber Tum Na Aaye
body:
Maa Sadqe Maa Wari Akber Tum Na Aaye
Ro-Ro Aarz Guzari Akbar Tum Na Aaye
Bara Gale Bandhe Hai Adu Ne Ek Rasan Me
Kuchh Ki Hai Tayyari Akber Tum Na Aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Kab Tak Apne muh Ko Chupaongi Balon Se
Chadar Legaye Nari Akber Tum Na Aaye
Chin Liye zalim Ne Sakina Ke Gouhar Tak
Loot Machi Hai Sari Akber Tum Na Aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum Bin mangti Rehti Hu Marne Ki Duaen
Listh Ladi Hai Bhari Akber Tum Na Aaye
Beta Tumari Raha Guzar Me Chalte Chalte
Bujh-Gayi Aankh Hamari Akber Tum Na Aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Chaha Hai Usne Tho Tumhe Betoun Se Zyada
Aye Zainab Dukyari Akber Tum Na Aaye
Shaam-e- Ghariba Me Baba Ka Pursa Dene
Aayi Ali Ki Sawari Akber Tum Na Aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Din Bhar Baithi Rahti Hai Raha Guzar Me
Kya Kare Sugra Bechari Akber Tum Na Aaye
Ab Bhi Sarosh Aati Hai Yahi Laila Ki Sadaye
Sun Kar Ki Zaari Akber Tum Na Aaye
